008package paint.viewer.ui.panels;
009
010import javax.swing.*;
011import java.awt.*;
012
013/**
014 * A simple reusable navigation component providing First, Previous, Next,
015 * and Last buttons for paging or record traversal within the viewer.
016 */
017public class NavigationPanel {
018
019    /**
020     * Listener interface for responding to navigation button events.
021     */
022    public interface Listener {
023        void onFirst();
024        void onPrev();
025        void onNext();
026        void onLast();
027    }
028
029    private final JPanel  root;
030    private final JButton firstBtn = new JButton("|<");
031    private final JButton prevBtn  = new JButton("<");
032    private final JButton nextBtn  = new JButton(">");
033    private final JButton lastBtn  = new JButton(">|");
034
035    /**
036     * Constructs a NavigationPanel with navigation buttons wired to a listener.
037     *
038     * @param listener a {@link Listener} implementation handling First, Previous,
039     *                 Next, and Last button events
040     */
041    public NavigationPanel(final Listener listener) {
042        root = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.CENTER, 10, 10));
043        root.add(firstBtn);
044        root.add(prevBtn);
045        root.add(nextBtn);
046        root.add(lastBtn);
047
048        firstBtn.addActionListener(e -> listener.onFirst());
049        prevBtn.addActionListener( e -> listener.onPrev());
050        nextBtn.addActionListener( e -> listener.onNext());
051        lastBtn.addActionListener( e -> listener.onLast());
052    }
053
054    /**
055     * Returns the root Swing component representing this navigation panel.
056     *
057     * @return the root {@link JComponent}
058     */
059    public JComponent getComponent() {
060        return root;
061    }
062
063    /**
064     * Updates the enabled/disabled state of the navigation buttons.
065     *
066     * @param hasPrev {@code true} to enable the First and Previous buttons
067     * @param hasNext {@code true} to enable the Next and Last buttons
068     */
069    public void setEnabledState(boolean hasPrev, boolean hasNext) {
070        firstBtn.setEnabled(hasPrev);
071        prevBtn.setEnabled(hasPrev);
072        nextBtn.setEnabled(hasNext);
073        lastBtn.setEnabled(hasNext);
074    }
075}
